observable_scope.claim: Only the uncoloured P1362 watch status bodies, their newline/channel envelope, their typed selection, their watch-only activation, and Compiling-before-compilation ordering are frozen.

duration_rule.Success: Append format_duration(duration) after the exact prefix `compiled successfully in `.
duration_rule.PartialSuccess: Append format_duration(duration) after the exact prefix `compiled with warnings in `.
duration_rule.Error: Contains no duration, separator, or timing suffix.

inputs.exit: The typed compile outcome/exit code, not diagnostic text.
inputs.has_warnings: A boolean computed from the typed warning collection before that collection is consumed or rendered.
inputs.elapsed: Duration from Instant captured immediately before the watched compilation call; its numeric value is not guaranteed.

selection.early_return_rule: Compile paths that return before producing a typed warning collection report has_warnings=false; they still select Error when exit is nonzero.
selection.forbidden_inference: No parsing, matching, counting, or inspection of stderr strings may determine has_warnings.

watch.before_each_compilation: Write `compiling ...\n` to stderr before invoking every initial or repeated watched compilation.
watch.after_outcome: Write exactly one selected final status body followed by exactly one newline to stderr for each completed watched compilation.
watch.multiplicity: Exactly one Compiling and one final status per completed watched compilation; a call that has not returned has no required final status.

ordinary_compile.rule: The non-watch compile path emits none of the four watch status bodies. Existing diagnostics remain outside this silence claim.

emission.stdout: No P1362 status bytes are written to stdout.
emission.colour: Not part of the frozen body; tests observe uncoloured text.
